response.title: My RV already has solar panels on the roof, can I use them to charge a portable power station too?
response.answer:
Yes! You can use the solar panels already installed on your RV roof to charge a portable power station (such as an EcoFlow, Bluetti, Jackery, or Anker).

The best way depends on how your RV's solar system is wired and whether you want to charge the RV batteries and portable power station simultaneously.

Three ways to do it
Shop

1. Connect the roof panels directly to the power station

Disconnect the panels from the RV solar controller and connect them to the power station's solar input using compatible cables.

Most efficient direct solar charging

The panel voltage, current, and polarity must be compatible with the power station. The panels cannot remain connected to the RV controller through the same direct connection.

Shop

2. Charge from the RV's existing battery system

Keep the rooftop solar connected to your RV batteries, then charge the portable power station from the RV's 12V system using a compatible, properly fused DC charging connection.

Best for keeping both systems working

This allows the solar panels to continue charging the RV batteries while the power station draws energy from them. Charging speed depends on the DC input and wiring.

Shop

3. Charge through an RV AC outlet

If your RV has an inverter supplying its outlets, you can plug the power station's AC charger into an outlet.

Easiest if your RV already has an inverter, but less efficient because electricity is converted from DC to AC and back to DC. Make sure the inverter and batteries can support the charging load.

Can the same panels charge both batteries?

Yes, but don't simply splice the solar panel wires into two different charge controllers. They can interfere with each other's operation.

A better setup is:

What RV do you have? (Brand, model, and year, if known.)

What portable power station do you have or plan to buy? (For example, EcoFlow Delta 2, Bluetti AC200L, Jackery Explorer 2000.)

With those, I can help determine whether you can use your existing rooftop solar directly, what cables or adapters you need, and how to charge both systems without rewiring everything.
